entities.name: Temperature controller
entities.detail: Uses the target to regulate brew temperature

entities.name: Brew temperature regulation
entities.detail: Regulates temperature toward the configured target
entities.current_behaviour: Brewing starts once temperature reaches the configured target.
entities.proposed_behaviour: Temperature must stay within ±1°C of the configured target for five continuous seconds before brewing starts.

review_questions.MOD-001: Does the controller gate brewing on five continuous seconds within tolerance and reset the timer when temperature leaves that band?
review_questions.REQ-001: Should the readiness requirement specify five continuous seconds within ±1°C before brewing starts?
review_questions.TEST-001: Do tests cover early-start prevention, successful readiness after five seconds, and timer reset after leaving tolerance?
review_questions.DOC-001: Does the specification explain the stability interval and the revised condition for starting brewing?

entities.name: Brew temperature tracking
entities.detail: Temperature shall track the configured target within ±1°C before brewing

entities.name: Brew temperature tracking test
entities.detail: Verifies tracking at the configured target; fixture currently uses 93°C

entities.name: Brew regulation specification
entities.detail: Describes brew temperature and pressure regulation and their configured targets

entities.name: Set brew temperature
entities.detail: References the parameter and currently states a 93°C default

entities.name: Brew target pressure
entities.detail: Configured brew pressure target, currently 9 bar

entities.name: Pump controller
entities.detail: Uses the pressure target to control the brew pump

entities.name: Brew pressure regulation
entities.detail: Regulates brew pressure toward the configured target
entities.current_behaviour: Regulates brew pressure toward the configured target during extraction.
entities.proposed_behaviour: Ramp pressure gradually to the configured target over the first three seconds of extraction.

entities.name: Brew pressure tracking
entities.detail: Brew pressure shall track the configured target within ±0.5 bar during extraction

entities.name: Brew pressure tracking test
entities.detail: Verifies pressure tracking at the configured target; fixture currently uses 9 bar

entities.name: Set brew pressure
entities.detail: References the pressure parameter and currently states a 9 bar default
